verdict.rationale: Apify ships an official CLI: a probe confirms docs at docs.apify.com/cli/, the docs say it lets you 'Control the Apify platform from terminal or shell scripts', and the quick-start shows the 'apify create my-first-actor' command. Nothing in the evidence shows the CLI is designed for AI-native or agentic use, and there is no independent corroboration, so coverage of the story as written is incomplete. Missing for 10: AI-agent-oriented CLI features (e.g. machine-readable/JSON output, non-interactive operation for agents), depth on the command reference, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Control the Apify platform from terminal or shell scripts.
